anchorTable.designReason: A 7 m wide pale-stone arrival drive ends at the protected pedestrian forecourt rather than at the house facade.
A broad, level arrival court provides a memorable pause between driveway and entry portal.
Central principal slab, top datum Y=0.2, holds the 192 m² shared living and entertaining pavilion.
A substantial west return provides a cool furniture/service wall and braces the open ocean elevation.
Matching east return frames the tall social volume without glazing every facade.
Landward wall contains the tall, real entrance opening and shields the living room from arrival.
Overscaled bronze pivot-style entry is fitted to the sill-zero rear wall opening and approached from the arrival court.
Tall fixed ocean glazing is held between limestone piers, preserving solid-to-glass balance.
Symmetrical second glazed bay preserves the framed panorama while leaving room for operable garden thresholds.
Real hinged garden door reserved in a sill-zero opening between glazing bays; it is the primary dry connection to the pool terrace.
Second real garden door supports two-sided pool and terrace circulation.
Thin 20 by 16 m flat roof has a 2 m deep perimeter shade line; underside remains above the 5.4 m living enclosure head.
West wing ground slab, top datum Y=0.2, contains Suite 01 and the west stair/lobby zone.
Grouped shell commitment for the lower west wing; later construction must split it into fitted facade bays and actual suite boundaries.
Suite 01 has a dedicated terrace-facing garden threshold.
Recessed upper west slab, top datum Y=3.64, accommodates Suites 02 and 03 while leaving an open lower ocean terrace.
Upper west accommodation enclosure is set back 2.5 m from the ocean edge for privacy and terrace depth.
Independent upper-wing roof clears the central living roof in plan and creates a shaded, low horizontal datum.
East wing ground slab mirrors the private capacity and keeps a generous central garden axis.
Grouped lower east wing shell to be articulated by exterior bays and suite boundaries in construction.
Suite 04 has a dedicated terrace-facing garden threshold.
Upper east slab top at Y=3.64 carries Suites 05 and 06 and is intended to be reached from the east stair.
Recessed upper east envelope balances the composition and protects its suites from direct pool activity.
Independent upper east roof repeats the wing roof datum and avoids crossing the central living volume.
32 m wide ocean terrace abuts the living threshold at the same Y=0.2 walking datum and reserves the pool footprint ahead.
Long rectangular water surface is set within a required explicit basin, coping, and dry circulation; it is not itself an infinity-edge claim.
Continuous 1 m coping perimeter at terrace datum establishes dry access around the water and a precise pool court edge.
A separate timber deck beyond the pool makes an outdoor lounge destination without invading the waterfront reserve.
Supported open elliptical lounge pavilion supplies a distinct shaded poolside destination; its fixed approved component geometry is intentionally retained.
Timber slatted screen filters views to the west wing and thickens the arrival court edge.
Matching screen balances the portal and conceals private-suite approach zones.
Editable layered planting mass marks a soft waterfront reserve beyond the pool without asserting specific plant species or shoreline works.

routesDetail.description: Level pedestrian approach from arrival court through the bronze main entry at Y=0.2.
Real sill-zero garden threshold from the great room to the continuous limestone terrace.
Dry route reaches the near pool coping without crossing water.
Reserved direct dry path along the east or west side of the basin to the pavilion deck.
Ground-level private route through a later-built west lobby connection.
Ground-level private route through a later-built east lobby connection.
Reserved enclosed west stair must rise 3.44 m from slab top Y=0.2 to upper slab top Y=3.64 with equal risers, landing, headroom, and real doors.
Reserved enclosed east stair must rise 3.44 m from slab top Y=0.2 to upper slab top Y=3.64 with equal risers, landing, headroom, and real doors.
